title: Soft Landscape Prep and Planting

header_fields.label: Project
header_fields.default: Curtin University B316 Sciences Project – External Works

completion_key: Completion key: ✓ = conforms × = does not conform (raise NCR below) N/A = not applicable to this area. Hold Points shaded grey – work must not proceed past a hold point until released in writing. Minimum 24 hours' notice of inspection to be given to LLB / the Superintendent in writing.

sections.title: A – PREPARATION – PRIOR TO SOIL PLACEMENT

items.text: IFC landscape drawings, planting plan, plant schedule and specification of current revision available on site
Work area inspected and formally accepted prior to taking possession – levels, surface condition and pre-existing defects notified in writing
Subgrade ripped / scarified for tree planting where required by design documentation
Subgrade graded to falls – free draining, no ponding, no smeared or sealed surfaces
Subsoil drainage installed where shown on landscape (ASPECT) and/or civil (WSP) drawings; outlets connected and clear
Spoil managed – stockpiles controlled and protected, or excess spoil removed

sections.title: B – PLANTER PREPARATION – GA03 / GA04 / INTERNAL PLANTERS

items.text: Waterproof membrane / lining verified intact and undamaged prior to overlay; protection layer in place
Drainage cell, reservoir layer and filter fabric installed to detail – laps, upturns and terminations correct
Washed sand and lightweight soil mix supplied and placed in line with design documentation
Planter drainage outlets clear and functional; discharge point confirmed and free flowing
Planter build-up inspected and approved prior to placing growing medium
items.notice: ■ HOLD POINT – 24 hrs notice to LL

items.text: Soil supplier conformance certificate / laboratory test results submitted and approved prior to delivery
Garden beds backfilled with approved imported topsoil only – no site spoil or unsuitable material used
Soil improver incorporated at specified rate (nom. 200 mm depth through top 300 mm depth, or as documented)
Growing medium placed and graded to design levels and falls; finished flush with adjacent surfaces allowing for full mulch depth
Soil lightly consolidated – no over-compaction, no voids, no perched layers or interfaces
Turf areas: topsoil placed to specified depth, levelled, lightly rolled and free of stones and debris
Irrigation mainline, laterals and sleeves installed, pressure tested and approved
Valve boxes, pit lids and sprinkler heads set to finished surface level, located in lawn/garden and clear of planting
Sprinkler offsets to edges, walls and pavements confirmed to standard detail
Where irrigation is not yet operational, temporary watering and maintenance plan in place and being executed
Plant stock conforms to schedule – species, cultivar, quantity, pot / container size
Mature and advanced tree stock supplied at heights nominated in landscape drawings and specification
Stock inspected on delivery – healthy, true to name, well established, free of pest, disease and weed
Plants stored, shaded and watered on site prior to planting; materials protected from damage
Plant stock inspected and accepted by LL prior to planting
items.notice: ■ HOLD POINT – 24 hrs notice to LL

items.text: Planting holes excavated to minimum twice rootball width; sides and base scarified, not glazed or smeared
Plants set plumb and at correct depth – root collar flush with finished soil level, not buried or proud
Backfill with approved topsoil placed and firmed in layers not exceeding 150 mm; no air voids
Trees: minimum 300 mm thick topsoil mixture around root ball, compacted to density of surrounding soil
All planting watered in thoroughly immediately after backfilling
Tree stakes and ties installed to detail – stakes clear of rootball, ties non-abrasive and not girdling
Planting densities, spacings and setout as per planting plan and schedule
Turf laid – joints staggered and close butted, no gaps or overlaps, rolled and watered in (TU01 and trenched areas)
Mulch type and sample submitted and approved prior to delivery
Mulch placed evenly to specified depth (nom. 75 mm or as documented) and kept clear of plant stems and tree trunks
Gravel mulch areas – filter fabric, gravel and screed installed in line with design documentation
Transitions to pre-existing landscape areas blended; no abrupt level changes
Finished levels and profile verified against architectural, landscape and civil drawings, within specified tolerances
Work area cleaned down – surplus material removed, hard surfaces swept, rubbish and debris cleared
Damaged or dead plant stock replaced; make good of new and pre-existing beds complete
Records compiled – delivery dockets, conformance certificates, soil test results, photographic record, survey setout
Protection to plants and completed areas in place and to remain until Practical Completion
Completed works inspected and accepted by LL
items.notice: ■ HOLD POINT – 24 hrs notice to LL

certification: This is to certify that the above results are a true record of the inspection, that ALL defects have been rectified to the acceptance of Lendlease Building and the Landscape Consultant, and that the soft landscape preparation and planting works comply with the requirements of the Subcontract, the Specification, the design documentation and the relevant Australian Standards.
